defects: The supplied recursive reference actually overflowed its stack on coins[1],amount10000.
Positive denomination/count/amount bounds and readonly ownership were unstated.
The recursive senior retained mapped child work instead of a bounded bottom-up state table.
rationale: Define at most20 positive integer denominations<=10000, duplicates/any order/frozen input and amount0..10000. Add a visible10000-unit case and three hidden assertions:672 subset/amount combinations against exhaustive denomination-count enumeration, readonly/duplicate/zero cases and max10000 with20 repeated unit coins. The BFS alternative passes; sorting the original coins passed old checks and now fails. Original6249/999 cases remain.

objective: Walk nested arrays once with bounded-depth frames and exact opaque leaf identity.

relevanceRationale.presentDay: Nested data traversal remains common JavaScript practice.
relevanceRationale.transferable: Opaque identity, undefined and source ownership transfer.
relevanceRationale.audienceFit: Bounded dense nesting keeps the objective testable.
relevanceRationale.riskOutcome: Native shortcuts bypass the learning goal; cloned leaves corrupt identity.

defects: All supplied boards copied child/growing results and did not support the authored linear work bound.
for-of failed dense arrays with null prototypes even though Array.isArray accepts them.
Native flat passed despite an explicit prohibition; opaque leaf identity and readonly/repeated-array behavior were untested.
rationale: Define dense acyclic nested arrays, at most20000 visited slots/depth64, frozen/null-prototype arrays, per-occurrence shared traversal and exact opaque non-array values. Use a shared output accumulator in reference/junior and array/index frames in senior; remove child-result copying. Update prompt/hints/approach/skeleton and author O(n)/O(d) extra storage excluding output, with n=root+slot visits. Add a visible object identity check and three hidden assertions:undefined/zero/NaN/BigInt/Symbol/cyclic-object/function/Date identity without leaf invocation,1555 constructed nested patterns with known leaf sequences and20k width/64depth/shared/null-prototype/fresh-result cases. Shared #431 policy makes only native Array flat/flatMap unavailable before initialization in Run/Submit/reused Learn. Focused contracts cover captured/reflected aliases, restoration attempts, valid custom method names, fresh other realms and unchanged host. Both a native shortcut and a leaf cloner passed old checks and now fail.

defects: Requested-length bounds and output freshness were unspecified.

rationale: Keep all three correct recursive boards. Define n0..12, equivalent zero input signs, exactly2^n distinct padded strings, fresh mutable arrays and output-character construction cost.
